baseline_models.focus_anchor: The interrogative possession frame binds a putative deity to otherness from God, then declares God free from their partnering.
baseline_models.mechanism: The worship-object branch identifies the office being claimed, otherness opens an exception slot, partnership makes that slot a proposed share, and absolution closes it. The verse tests an allegedly possessed worship relation, not merely a count of supernatural beings.

activation_trace.role: Worship and its object supply the relational office whose alleged alternative is tested.
Otherness, exception, and negation open the proposed outside slot while marking its exclusion.
Shared possession and participation expose the claim as allocation of a divine share.
Making or equating a partner with God names the closing accusation directly.
Declaring free and distancing performs the answer by clearing God of the proposed composite relation.

changed_reading.before: A bare denial that another deity exists.
changed_reading.after: A challenge to anyone claiming possession of an alternative worship relation, followed by an active clearing of God from every shared allocation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus joins the worship-object, other-than, absolution, and active partnering constructions in one short sequence.
baseline_models.mechanism: The substitution branch of otherness and the shared-portion branch of partnering combine into a transfer model: another object is inserted into a relation whose devotion is then divided. Absolution reverses that transfer by refusing the composite.

activation_trace.role: Worship and the worshipped one define what is being redirected.
Changing form or substituting one thing for another supplies the transfer operation.
A shared portion turns substitution into divided participation rather than simple replacement.
Absolution and distancing undo the attempted transfer and mixture.

changed_reading.before: The verse rejects adding a second god beside God.
changed_reading.after: The verse also rejects redirecting any share of devotion by substituting another object into the God-relation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural active partnering verb remains tied to the worship-object and absolution constructions in the focus verse.
baseline_models.mechanism: The divided or preoccupied mind branch makes partnering an inwardly repeated act: allegiance loses unity before it becomes a public pantheon. The absolution construction then refuses projection of that inner division onto God.

activation_trace.role: The worship relation keeps the inward reading anchored to the deity construction.
A mind or opinion that is not one supplies the literal image for divided allegiance.
Otherness and difference provide the competing pole around which allegiance splits.
Declaring God free blocks the divided mind from making divine reality share its fracture.

changed_reading.before: Partnering is only an external creed about multiple deities.
changed_reading.after: Partnering can also diagnose divided allegiance: the worshipper's ununified judgment is projected outward and then refused.

context_deltas.mechanism: The early context moves from a limit, through elevation, to an event that falls or becomes fixed and cannot be pushed aside. Read as control transitions, these images turn the alternative-deity question into a jurisdiction test: where could an independent edge or counterforce enter this ordering?

activation_trace.role: The worshipped office is tested for any independently operative claimant.
Shared participation supplies the rival-jurisdiction hypothesis.
A limit at which one stops or crosses supplies a jurisdictional edge.
Raising supplies an ordering act that places the structure rather than sharing its support.
Falling and becoming fixed supply the transition from suspended order to unavoidable event.
Pushing harm aside supplies the missing counterforce: the event has no such repeller.

structural_cues: The opening sequence moves from marked limits and raised structure to cosmic disturbance, a fixed event, and the statement that it has no repeller.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies boundary, elevation, fall, and repulsion images; I infer that control across those transitions marks jurisdiction. A live alternative is that the sequence stages judgment only and does not define deity.

changed_reading.before: No second object of worship is allowed.
changed_reading.after: No independent jurisdictional edge, support, or counterforce is visible from which another worshipped power could operate.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context affirms pairing and attachment across generations while retaining each person's right-bound accountability. That contrast makes the focus precise: relation and plurality are not the problem; transferring or sharing the worshipped office is.

activation_trace.role: The worshipped office identifies the nontransferable relation at issue.
Shared possession provides the kind of joining that the focus rejects in this office.
Joining a peer to its peer supplies an affirmed form of pairing.
A later party reaching those ahead supplies permitted attachment across generations.
A right-held pledge preserves individual accountability inside the attachment.

structural_cues: Pairing and family attachment are immediately qualified by the statement that each person remains held by what was acquired.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies permitted pairing, attachment, and retained obligation; I infer a contrast between legitimate joining and illicit sharing of divine office. Alternatively, the reward scene may not be intended as a taxonomy of partnering.

changed_reading.before: The focus rejects partnership without explaining how it differs from other joins.
changed_reading.after: The focus marks a category boundary: created relations may join persons while the worshipped office cannot be divided or transferred.

context_deltas.mechanism: Before the focus, calling God leads to protection, expansive goodness, and mercy; after it, their scheme cannot suffice and receives no aid. This brackets deity as the ultimate addressee and effective rescuer, so partnering becomes divided dependence rather than an abstract classification alone.

activation_trace.role: Worship and its object define the relation tested by call, protection, and aid.
Shared participation becomes divided recourse to more than one supposed rescuer.
The fixed divine name identifies the one invoked in the surrounding testimony.
Protection that pushes harm away supplies the effective answer to dependence.
Calling and inclining by speech supply the directed act that selects an addressee.
Expansive goodness supplies the beneficent quality encountered by the callers.
Mercy and tenderness complete the relational response to the call.
Sufficiency is explicitly absent from their scheme, disqualifying it as a saving resource.
Aid and vindicating support supply the rescue function that no partner provides.

structural_cues: The first-person testimony links prior calling to protection before the polemical question series.
After the focus, the repeated scheme is said to provide neither sufficiency nor help.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies directed call, protection, goodness, mercy, failed sufficiency, and absent aid; I infer that these functionally identify the deity relation. They may alternatively describe outcomes of worship rather than define deity.

changed_reading.before: The alternative deity is a rival entity in a doctrine.
changed_reading.after: The alternative deity is any rival addressee to whom ultimate dependence, protection, sufficiency, or rescue is assigned.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding questions test being created without a thing, self-creation, and creation of the heavens and earth. Repetition of the otherness operator makes the focus question the closure of that causal series: an alternative deity would require an outside slot that the series has already rendered ungrounded.

activation_trace.role: The worshipped office is the final claimant tested by the causal alternatives.
Otherness and exception mark the alleged ontological outside slot in the focus.
Bringing creation into being supplies both the passive-origin and self-creator alternatives.
The repeated otherness and negation operator links causal absence to the later rival-deity slot.
A knowable, predicable thing supplies the missing source term in the origin question.
Creating the heavens and earth scales the causal test from self-origin to total order.

structural_cues: The focus repeats both the am interrogative and the ghayr construction used in the origin question eight verses earlier.
The intervening questions continue testing creation and control rather than opening a new topic.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated syntax, otherness, and creation alternatives; I infer that the questions constrain one causal graph. A live alternative is that they are parallel attacks whose syntax does not require ontological closure.

changed_reading.before: The focus asserts exclusive deity after unrelated rhetorical questions.
changed_reading.after: The focus closes the causal alternatives: no ungrounded outside slot remains from which an alternative deity could arise or claim creation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Treasuries, supervisory control, a ladder or means of access, hearing, compelling proof, the hidden, and binding inscription form an imagined private infrastructure. Repeated possession frames make the focus deity the last alleged asset in that system, exposing an attempt to domesticate transcendence as owned access and delegated control.

activation_trace.role: The worshipped one becomes the culminating item they are challenged to claim as theirs.
Shared participation supplies the imagined delegation within the private control system.
Nearness and presence supply the idiom of having privileged resources at hand.
Guarded storage supplies the alleged reserve over which they claim access.
A coercive supervisory controller supplies the claimed administrative office.
A ladder as ascent and means supplies a private access channel.
Understanding and compliance turn overhearing into a claim of actionable reception.
Compelling proof supplies the demanded credential for the alleged channel.
What is screened from eyes supplies the inaccessible information they claim to hold.
An inscription that imposes judgment turns claimed hidden access into asserted decree.

structural_cues: The am questions repeatedly use possession or at-hand constructions before returning to the same possession frame for the focus deity.
The sequence progresses from reserves and control through access and proof to hidden knowledge and writing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reserves, control, access, reception, proof, hiddenness, and binding record; I infer that the repeated possessives assemble one imagined access system. The items may alternatively be separate boasts rather than one infrastructure.

changed_reading.before: The question asks only whether a different deity exists.
changed_reading.after: The question ridicules the claim that a rival deity is something they privately possess as an access point, credential, or delegated controller.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent questions allocate offspring asymmetrically, then test fee, liability, and burden. Activated by partnership as a shared portion and otherness as alternative legal compensation, the focus becomes the final ledger challenge: by what allocation can anyone assign God kin, shares, or an alternate office while refusing the cost?

activation_trace.role: The worshipped office is the purported asset being allocated.
A shared possession or portion supplies the ledger's distributive operation.
Alternative legal compensation supplies a form-distant image of substituting what is owed.
Sonship and attribution to an origin supply the kinship entries being distributed.
Compensation for work supplies the possible charge in the exchange.
A financial liability that clings supplies the debt side of the ledger.
Being loaded with a burden makes the rejected cost materially felt.

structural_cues: Adjacent am questions contrast what is assigned to Him and to them, then move immediately to fee and crushing liability before the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies kinship attribution, fee, debt, burden, shared portion, and alternative compensation; I infer a single allocation ledger. The legal-compensation branch is form-distant, and the questions may instead be independent satire.

changed_reading.before: Partnering is an abstract mistake of multiplying deity.
changed_reading.after: Partnering is also an asymmetric allocation practice: inventing divine kin or shares, assigning the benefits, and evading the liability.

context_deltas.mechanism: An intended scheme reverses onto its makers, then recurs as a scheme that neither suffices nor gains aid. The snare branch of partnering turns association into the entangling device itself: God is cleared from their strategy, while the strategists are caught in the alternate-power route they constructed.

activation_trace.role: A hunter's snare supplies the material image by which partnering catches its own makers.
Absolution and distancing keep God outside the reversing scheme.
Will and intention supply the initiating agency behind the scheme.
Contrivance and deception supply both the launched scheme and its reversal onto them.
Covering the truth identifies the agents whose concealed strategy reverses.
The repeated contrivance returns after the focus as an explicitly useless device.
Absent sufficiency shows that the device cannot secure its users.
Absent aid confirms that no partner can extract them from the reversed device.

structural_cues: The scheme-and-reversal statement directly precedes the focus.
Three verses later the same scheme is repeated inside a no-sufficiency and no-help frame.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies intention, contrivance, reversal, failure, and the focus root's snare image; I infer that partnering is the trap mechanism. Alternatively, the scheme may concern opposition to the message while partnering remains only an adjacent charge.

changed_reading.before: Their partners are false objects from which God is remote.
changed_reading.after: Constructing alternate partners is a self-entangling strategy: it reverses onto its makers and supplies neither sufficiency nor rescue.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after the focus, a seen falling fragment is verbally replaced by a piled-cloud category. The substitution branch of otherness and divided-mind branch of partnering make this a model of epistemic association: perception is split from naming so an old allegiance can survive contrary appearance.

activation_trace.role: Substituting one thing for another supplies the relabeling operation.
A mind or opinion that is not one supplies the split between sight and asserted category.
Absolution keeps divine reality free of the observers' replacement label.
Seeing by eye and insight supplies the initial evidence channel.
A detached piece of a body or sky supplies the object actually presented to sight.
Falling downward supplies the observed event that demands classification.
Saying what was not or assigning it supplies the verbal overwrite of the observation.
A drawn-along cloud supplies the replacement category.
Things piled one over another make the replacement label visually plausible.

structural_cues: The focus is followed immediately by a conditional sequence of seeing, falling, saying, and recategorizing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an observed falling piece and a spoken piled-cloud label; I infer defensive reclassification that protects prior allegiance. A live alternative is sincere visual misidentification rather than motivated epistemic substitution.

changed_reading.before: Other gods are external objects added to belief.
changed_reading.after: Other-god making also operates as a habit of replacement naming: contrary evidence is recategorized so divided allegiance need not change.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus noun of absolution is expanded into repeated imperatives aligned with rising, night, and the recession of stars. What looked like a closing exclamation becomes a temporal counterpractice that repeatedly clears allegiance from shared claims across daily and cosmic transitions.

activation_trace.role: Absolution and declaring free provide the focus act that later imperatives operationalize.
Shared participation identifies what the repeated practice continually clears away.
Worship through praise and prayer turns the focus declaration into commanded practice.
Praise opposed to blame gives the repeated practice an affirmative content.
Bodily rising supplies the first recurring transition at which the practice is enacted.
Night and its darkness extend the practice into another temporal field.
The repeated worship imperative confirms that the focus act is not a one-time interjection.
The end and passing aftermath of a thing supply a threshold at which allegiance is renewed.
The rising celestial body gives the closing threshold a cosmic clock.

structural_cues: The same focus root returns twice as an imperative in the two closing verses.
The commands are attached to bodily and temporal transitions rather than left as detached doctrine.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies root repetition, imperatives, praise, rising, night, endings, and stars; I infer that the closing commands operationalize the focus absolution as anti-partnership discipline. They may alternatively be general consolation and worship rather than a targeted antidote.

changed_reading.before: The absolution phrase is a brief doctrinal exclamation after the question.
changed_reading.after: The absolution phrase seeds a repeated embodied practice that keeps worship unshared through daily and cosmic transitions.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates motion and road-track branches rather than the ordinary absolution and partnership branches. It remains anchored in the focus roots and is bracketed by sky, mountain, and star movement. Render it only as an exploratory kinetic overlay, not as a replacement lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus absolution root has a coursing branch, while the partnering root has a branch of road ruts and diverging tracks.

activation_trace.role: Swimming or coursing through water, air, or an orbit supplies the kinetic clearing motion.
Main ruts and branching tracks supply the divided routes from which the motion clears free.
Oscillation and wave-like motion activate a moving rather than static cosmic field.
Going and flowing extend that field through the movement of mountains.
Passing into the latter end supplies the closing direction of motion.
The rising star supplies a celestial body coursing through the final threshold.

changed_reading.before: Absolution is a static verbal separation from partners.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, absolution courses free of the fixed ruts and branching tracks by which allegiance is partitioned.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it contrasts a filled, mixed, or kindled sea with divine non-partnership. It remains anchored through the focus sharing and absolution roots plus the sea's supplied material branches. Render it as an analogy distinguishing created mixtures from divine composition, not as a claim that the focus directly describes matter.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus juxtaposes shared participation with declaring God free, allowing a material admixture contrast without leaving its roots.

activation_trace.role: Mixing of partners and shared possession supply the prohibited divine admixture.
Purifying and declaring free supply the refusal of composition at the divine level.
Vast abundant water supplies the created material field in which mixture can occur.
Mixing in companionship and affection supplies an authorized created admixture.
Kindling and intensifying fire makes the created mixture materially unstable and dynamic.

changed_reading.before: The focus rejects theological partnership in purely abstract terms.
changed_reading.after: The context permits mixture and transformation within creation while the focus denies that divine identity can be mixed, portioned, or kindled into a composite.

strongest_changes: The repeated creation and otherness questions close the imagined ontological outside slot for another deity.
The possession-access sequence recasts a rival deity as a claimed private asset, credential, or delegated controller.
The call-protection and failed-aid frame makes deity relational: the ultimate addressee and effective rescuer cannot be shared.
The post-focus relabeling scene exposes other-god making as epistemic substitution, while the closing imperatives turn absolution into repeated counterpractice.
summary.what_was_special: The same compact focus supported coexisting jurisdictional, relational, ontological, administrative, economic, epistemic, ritual, and material readings. The odd branches did not replace the strong worship-partnership baseline; they revealed mechanisms that baseline alone would hide.
remaining_uncertainties: The repeated am and ghayr syntax may create one causal argument or only a series of parallel challenges.
The allocation-ledger reading depends on a form-distant legal-compensation branch and should remain exploratory.
The snare, kinetic, and material-admixture models are anchored analogies, not secure lexical glosses.
The closing praise practice may specifically counter partnering or may function as broader worship and consolation.
